articles.title: Spotify Seems to Be Teasing a GTA 6 Collaboration with Rockstar Games
articles.summary: Spotify appears to be the next big streaming giant to partner with Rockstar Games for GTA 6's marketing. The music streaming service has begun putting up billboards in Los Angeles and New York featuring the GTA 6 artwork that was released by various artists yesterday.
body: Many assumed that this was Rockstar's way of teasing these artists might have music in the game, but it may be much bigger than that. Some running theories have speculated that the artists could release exclusive music for GTA 6, something Rockstar did with Dr. Dre for a GTA Online update a few years ago. However, Spotify's inclusion may mean there's even more to this; the platform might provide exclusive teases of some music that could be featured in GTA 6 ahead of the game's release as part of its marketing push.

Some have also theorized that GTA 6 may have some kind of Spotify integration, allowing users to listen to their own Spotify playlists in-game. Given how much money Rockstar spends on curating music for its games and how much effort goes into crafting its radio stations, it seems difficult to imagine this, but it's entirely possible. Either way, it's clear Spotify has some kind of partnership with Rockstar Games on GTA 6.

articles.title: GTA 5 Franklin Voice Actor Clears the Air After Calling Out Twitch Star Kai Cenat for Allegedly Breaking Promise to a Young Fan
articles.summary: The voice actor behind GTA 5’s Franklin went viral after revealing his personal disagreement with famous Twitch steamer Kai Cenat, but the two stars are on good terms again. Shawn ‘Solo’ Fonteno is the voice behind one of Grand Theft Auto ’s most iconic characters, Franklin Clinton.
body: However, Solo said this was likely the last stream he’d ever do with Cenat due to the broadcaster’s interaction with a young fan that happened during their outing.

In a September 2026 episode of the Dope As Usual podcast, Solo explained that Kai Cenat approached a young fan during the stream who came from a struggling family. According to Solo, Cenat had offered to buy the fan a motorcycle — but Solo says he never made good on that promise.

“This was a family that didn’t have much at all, bro,” he recalled. “It was probably 15 people living in a one-bedroom home. I know these people, and I help them out at times. …Kai was cool, cordial with them, talking to them, ‘What you want? What can I get you?’ And the kid was like, ‘I wanna bike, can you get me a bike?’ He said, ‘What kind of bike?’ and the kid said, ‘A motorcycle!’ He said, ‘We gon’ make it happen.’
Solo said he even approached Kai’s friend and fellow streamer Fanum about the issue, who the actor says ignored him.

articles.title: Metroid Ravenous Logo Memes Make Phrases Like “Girl Dinner” And “They Took My Ass” Look So Metal
articles.summary: Hype emanating from the reveal of Metroid Ravenous has translated into an onslaught of memes after a logo generator circulated online. If you're on Reddit or Bluesky, you may have seen the instantly iconic image of Samus Aran aggressively pinning down a mysterious enemy for consumption, but now…
body: The Pixelframe Design website unveiled a tool that lets anyone input any text and style it to look like the grainy and jagged Metroid Ravenous logo, with four options for the image background. Pixelframe Design previously made similar logo generators for games like GTA 6, The Duskbloods, and famously, Pokopia.

The apparent hook of Metroid Ravenous is Samus's need to kill and consume her enemies to survive. Naturally, that has led to food-related memes like a riff on the "55 burgers" scene from I Think You Should Leave, a reference to the viral concept of "girl dinner," or a simple but effective "Om Nom Nom" joke. Literally any wording you put into the generator will look more badass in this font.

It's also been amusing to see other video game titles like Hello Kitty Island Adventure in the Ravenous font face, and several other of these memes are just vulgar and gross enough to be hilarious. Don't expect any of this to become official Nintendo marketing material.

The Metroid subreddit was briefly jam-packed with these images, leading to moderators creating a megathread devoted to the meme template. Hilariously, many of the top-upvoted comments are Ravenous memes dunking on the mods.

articles.title: The WD Green SN3000 1TB PCIe 4.0 M.2 NVME Solid State Drive (SSD) Drops to $129 at Newegg
articles.summary: Newegg is offering one of the lowest prices I've seen this year for a brand name M.2 SSD. Newegg via its official AliExpress storefront is offering a WD Green SN3000 1TB PCIe 4.0 M.2 NVMe Solid State Drive for an impressively low price of $129.48 with free shipping after you apply $15 off coupon…
body: The WD Green SN3000 is fast for a "budget" M.2 SSD. This is a DRAM-less PCI-E 4x4 drive equipped with SanDisk's QLC 3D NAND memory and boasting transfer speeds of up to 5,000MB/s read and 4,200MB/s write. This is an ideal boot drive for your gaming PC, but it's also fully compatible with the PlayStation 5 console. It's a bit under Sony's recommended minimum requirement of 5,5000MB/s, but you likely won't notice the speed difference except maybe during game installations when you are moving large files.

Installing an SSD in your PlayStation 5 console is super easy and won't void your warranty. It's also a near essential upgrade. With games taking up as much as 100GB apiece, it's very easy to max out the PS5's stock 1TB storage (which is actually just 667MB of usable storage ). In fact, it's not unheard of for an avid PS5 gamer to cap out even with 2TB.

Although you can get by without a heatsink, Sony officially recommends one, as noted in their FAQ section in their install guide. The WD Green SN3000 doesn't include one out of the box. Fortunately, you can find one on Amazon for about $6 and they're very simple to install (most are attached with adhesive).
points: Newegg is offering one of the lowest prices I've seen this year for a brand name M.2 SSD.

articles.title: RAVEN2 - ZERO Lets Players Enter an Apocalyptic MMORPG Where Growth Is Tied to Gameplay
articles.summary: Netmarble's Raven2 is a blockbuster dark fantasy MMORPG with a player base that covers the globe. Fans from 155 countries can't get enough of creating their own custom avatar down to the last detail before guiding them through a strife-filled world where you're often forced to fight for your very…
body: With so much fighting in Raven2, it's easy to feel "shut out" of the adventure before you even have a chance to get your bearings. The Raven2 – Zero server update lets you get a fresh start with less pressure to spend money. Thanks to its redesigned progression system and overhauled competitive structure, less-entrenched Raven2 players can quickly get a foothold in the game just by playing it and earning valuable rewards. That means the Zero update lets you remain competitive in its apocalyptic world without fear of getting merc'd because you didn't pay up to get an edge over everyone else.

Raven2 – Zero lets you choose from 10 different classes, with each one offering a new combat style. Marked with the dreaded Cursed Stigma, your role is to vanquish demons and monsters as you travel across the world to investigate strange happenings in a dying land.

articles.title: Resident Evil Director Was In Horrible Pain Making The Movie
articles.summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed he was going through hell while making the movie, which is about a man going through hell. He told The Hollywood Reporter that he had pneumonia for the first half of filming on Resident Evil.
body: "So I was very, very ill for the whole production, and everything felt so barely in control because my body was failing me," Cregger explained.

Cregger said he credits his "wonderful, talented" department leads to help him through, while he also praised Resident Evil star Austin Abrams for going above and beyond. He said Abrams is "one of the most can-do, positive people I’ve ever met. I was spoiled by the people around me."

Not only was Cregger physically sick while making Resident Evil, he had to deal with freezing-cold conditions in the north of the Czech Republic where the movie was filmed. "We froze our asses off," he said.
This wasn't the first time Cregger was dealing with physical turmoil while making a movie. On his last film, Weapons, it was so hot and humid that he needed an IV and directed scenes remotely.

articles.title: Resident Evil Is Now The Highest-Rated Gaming Movie Ever
articles.summary: The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger releases in theaters on September 18. Reviews from critics went live today, and the movie is earning high scores.
body: In fact, it's now the highest-rated video game movie ever. It boasts a mightily impressive 96% on Rotten Tomatoes from 71 reviews and an equally impressive 80 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic. According to Metacritic, Resident Evil is the highest-rated video game movie ever, well ahead of another 2026 movie, Exit 8, which has a 71 Metascore.

The six Resident Evil movies that Paul W.S. Anderson made did not score very high with critics, with 2016's The Final Chapter topping them all at 49% on Metacritic. The latest Resident Evil movie before Cregger's, 2021's Welcome to Raccoon City from director Johannes Roberts, scored a 44% on Metacritic.

After that movie came out, Constantin, which has owned the movie rights to Resident Evil since the '90s, intended to put the franchise on hiatus. However, Cregger, coming off the success of Barbarian, pitched Constantin on his new, original take, and Constantin loved it so much that they put it into production.

articles.title: South Park’s New Season Is Officially the Biggest Sitcom on Streaming After Just 1 Episode
articles.summary: "South American Biker Gangs" is South Park 's debut as South America, and it's also the first episode of season 29. It seems that fans were particularly curious about how the show would handle this rebranding, as it quickly became the most-watched sitcom on a global scale after a single episode…
body: South America, most commonly referred to as South Park, is in its 29th season, an impressive feat for any TV show. Each season that goes by perfectly captures the times that we live in, as it often references and ridicules real-life events that are widely discussed around the world. If there's something creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone aren't afraid of, it's using satire to make their voices heard.

President Donald Trump has been the show's main target in the past few seasons. And it doesn't stop at jokes; South Park has actually changed its name to South America as a way to criticize Trump's decision — and Apple and Google's willingness to kowtow — to change the names of the Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario, updating each geographical location with "America."

This was a huge deal, as the title is a big part of a show's essence. It looks like this change caught fans' attention, as within a day, it became the most-watched sitcom on streaming services across the globe. Apparently, thousands of viewers rushed to Paramount Plus to watch it once it went live. It was the runner-up for most popular TV show on Paramount Plus, topped only by Lioness.

articles.title: Lego Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight Gives Harley Quinn An Arkham Asylum Makeover
articles.summary: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was a fun tribute to the Caped Crusader when it launched earlier this year, but if you're tired of saving Gotham, you can embrace chaos with two of the city's greatest villains: Harley Quinn and the Joker.
body: While Harley Quinn predominantly wore a jester's outfit throughout her appearances in Batman: The Animated Series and related comic books, Rocksteady's Arkham Asylum game saw her switch up her look dramatically for what can best be described as a doctor-themed dominatrix. Out with the spandex onesie, in with a repurposed doctor's outfit, leather corset, domino mask, and other elements that paid homage to her roots. In Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, this costume is described as having prankster pigtails and a "chaotic" corset.

In case you missed it, the Mayhem Collection draws heavily from Batman: The Animated Series, with developer TT Games calling the expansion a love letter to the landmark '90s show that introduced Harley Quinn as the Joker's sidekick. Fans can find several references to the series in the Mayhem Collection, along with Easter eggs for other Batman shows, films, games, and comic book stories. There's even a nod to Harley Quinn's original voice actor, the late Arleen Sorkin, and the new story mission chronicles the first meeting between the Joker and Quinn, back when she was still the ambitious psychiatrist Dr. Harleen Quinzel.

articles.title: Guy Ritchie’s 128-minute Action Movie Is Officially the Biggest Detective Thriller on Streaming
articles.summary: Sherlock Holmes, Guy Ritchie's action-packed take on the classic detective, is finding a new audience on Apple TV.
body: Guy Ritchie has never been particularly interested in making polite British movies about polite British people.

The filmmaker built his career on stylish crime movies full of fast-talking gangsters, elaborate schemes, and sudden bursts of violence. That formula has served him well with projects like The Gentlemen, his Netflix series about an aristocrat who inherits a family estate and discovers a sprawling marijuana empire.

Ritchie has also leaned further into action in recent years. The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare turned a group of British military operatives into a swaggering action crew, while this year's In the Grey paired Jake Gyllenhaal and Henry Cavill for a globe-trotting heist that spirals into all-out war. It wasn't a critical hit, but it had plenty of the slick action Ritchie is known for.
Now, one of Ritchie's older movies is getting another shot at the spotlight on streaming.
points: Sherlock Holmes, Guy Ritchie's action-packed take on the classic detective, is finding a new audience on Apple TV.

articles.title: Magic: The Gathering Officially Reveals the Ur-Dragon's New Commander Replacement
articles.summary: In Magic: The Gathering, the Command Zone often feels like a liminal space. Your Commander is always on full display outside your deck, but it’s also not officially in play.
body: Eminence appears on two of the three most popular Commanders ever, according to data from EDHREC. That’s because it gives The Ur-Dragon and Edgar Markov a persistent ability that functions even when they remain in the Command Zone — safe from any kind of interaction from other players. Their designer, Gavin Verhey, previously admitted in a January 2025 video that Eminence was too powerful and a mechanic he “shouldn’t have made.” And yet, Eminence is back in a huge way with the upcoming Reality Fracture set.

Verhey appeared in a Commander Showcase preview video published Wednesday in which he outlined the new Multiverse Reforged preconstructed Commander deck alongside The Command Zone podcast host Rachel Weeks, content creator Reggie The Arcade, and actor Jacob Bertrand.

Multiverse Reforged is a four-color deck (white-blue-black-red) led by Jace, Multiverse Architect, a planeswalker card showcasing the villainous version of Jace responsible for creating the Echoverse. The deck’s core strategy is essentially polymorph: create small, expendable creature tokens, then exchange them for more dangerous creatures from your library. One of the most dangerous of them all is The Ur-Sphinx.

articles.title: Wardogs studio CEO issues new statement, after backlash for saying his studio won't hire people who "constantly tweet anti-crunch messaging"
articles.summary: Joe Brammer, CEO of Bulkhead, the developer behind The Turing Test, Battalion 1944, and now the hugely successful new release Wardogs, has found himself in somewhat hot water, following a revealing interview where he discussed work culture at the UK studio.
body: After a day of heated social media debate and an initial response via X, Brammer has now issued a statement to Eurogamer. In it, he explains the exact nature of the studio's "crunch" practices, and clarifies that his mention of monitoring the social media of potential applicants to the studio - a potential legal grey area in the UK - was a case of "speaking informally about our culture".

To rewind a little, the response to Brammer's comments began following his recent appearance on The Game Business, where he discussed a number of topics around the culture and running of the Bulkhead studio and, when the conversation shifted to crunch, revealed he expects his team to do so where necessary.

articles.title: Baldur's Gate 3 Officially Adds 19 Game-Breaking Options for Console Players
articles.summary: Larian Studios just ended the longest gap between Baldur’s Gate 3 console mod drops in recent memory. But the wait was worth it: Now, players have a new recruitable goblin villain — welcome to the party, Sazza! — and…a frog with a greatsword?
body: With this latest batch of approved mods, Xbox and PlayStation players can guarantee Minthara’s only knocked unconscious instead of killed in Act 1’s goblin camp encounter, give Shadowheart a full set of hand-drawn tattoos, and finally pose Dame Aylin for a proper photo shoot. Wondering which of the 19 is worth a download and a replay right now? Here’s where to start.

Sazza Evolved: Sazza, a goblin scout you can choose to rescue on three separate occasions across the game’s story, only to watch her leave every single time, is now a recruitable character. With this mod installed, you can finally invite a goblin ally to your party.

To grab any of these mods, boot up Baldur’s Gate 3 on Xbox or PlayStation and check the in-game Mod Manager from the main menu. Console mods don’t route through Nexus Mods or any outside site the way PC ones do, so everything you need is already built into the game itself. Make sure you’re on the latest patch, first: New approvals sometimes take a day or two to actually show up in the manager after Larian signs off on them.
points: Larian Studios just ended the longest gap between Baldur’s Gate 3 console mod drops in recent memory.

articles.title: More MindsEye developers have been laid off, and GTA veteran Leslie Benzie's studio is reportedly shutting down
articles.summary: Another round of layoffs is seemingly sweeping through Build A Rocket Boy, the studio responsible for MindsEye and founded by GTA veteran Leslie Benzies. The studio's future is now uncertain.
body: Reported on by IGN, more staff working at Build A Rocket Boy have said they've been let go. Head of audio Stuart Ross, level designer Liam Shannon, release manager Michaela Emslie, lead QA analyst Sandy Greig, QA analyst Elizabet Tyaneva, production QA analyst Cameron Deaves, and many more recently announced their time at the studio is coming to a close.

This certainly isn't the first time Build A Rocket Boy has cut jobs following the messy launch (and even more messy aftermath) of MindsEye. Last year, the company made an unknown number of staff redundant. In May, the studio reportedly laid off a further 170 workers. Remaining staff also staged a protest this summer against Build A Rocket Boy's "all expenses paid" fan event.
These most recent layoffs also call into question the future of the entire company. Kotaku reports that sources close to the studio claim Build A Rocket Boy is permanently shutting down.

articles.title: Monster Hunter Wilds will soon stop charging players to edit their characters as Capcom scraps the game's worst microtransaction
articles.summary: Arguably Monster Hunter Wilds ' most egregious microtransaction is being retired, and, soon, you'll be able to edit your hunters and cat-friend Palicos whenever you like, as many times as you like.
body: Publisher Capcom waved goodbye to the divisive Edit Vouchers earlier today. Starting from 3 December, the vouchers will be pulled from all digital storefronts and players will instead get 10 Character Edit Vouchers and 10 Palico Edit Vouchers for free.

Those vouchers should tide you over until the release of Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance sometime next year, at which point "all players will be able to re-edit the appearance of their hunter and Palico as many times as they like, free of charge and without the need for a Character Edit Voucher." Even if you're not planning on picking up the Ascendance expansion, you'll still be able to give your characters a makeover ad nauseum, I should add.

Mildly whelming news for anyone who's already spent real-world money on rejigging your big beast battlers: you won't be refunded, but Capcom will give you an in-game pendant set "as a token of our appreciation." You can claim the Special Thank-You Pendant Set, which includes the Heavenly Hog and Beelzeboar pendants, starting from 3 December, as well. Gosh, this series has the best monster names.

videos.title: This PHYSINT What People Want, Sony
videos.summary: When Xbox snatched Hideo Kojima’s PHYSINT out from under Sony’s nose, it felt less like a standard corporate pivot and more like WCW poaching Hulk Hogan at the onset of the Monday Night Wars.
body: This video breaks down the full story behind Hideo Kojima's PHYSINT moving to Xbox, Sony's surprising cancellation of Metal Gear Solid's spiritual successor, and what it means for the future of PlayStation and Xbox. With new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma securing Kojima Productions’ upcoming action-espionage game alongside OD, Microsoft is attempting a massive reset of its exclusive lineup. With Xbox looking ascendant, and Sony’s controversial shift away from single-player narrative games and the fallout from live-service missteps like Concord, are the two platform holders going to swap places soon?
points: When Xbox snatched Hideo Kojima’s PHYSINT out from under Sony’s nose, it felt less like a standard corporate pivot and more like WCW poaching Hulk Hogan at the onset of the Monday Night Wars.
Snagging the auteur behind Metal Gear Solid, the very franchise that established PlayStation's reputation for prestige storytellingm, is a massive PR flex loaded with symbolism, proving Microsoft is…
But as wrestling history proves, signing the biggest icon in the business doesn't guarantee a long-term win if internal hubris and ballooning budgets take over the show.
With new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma securing Kojima Productions’ upcoming action-espionage game alongside OD, Microsoft is attempting a massive reset of its exclusive lineup.

videos.title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Trailer | Capcom Spotlight TGS 2026
videos.summary: Get a look at the world you'll explore and the monsters you'll face in Monster Hunter Outlanders in this new trailer for the upcoming open-world action RPG. In Monster Hunter Outlanders, race across vast fields and set out on journeys into the unknown with your allies.
body: Monster Hunter Outlanders will be available on the App Store and Google Play, with pre-registration available now.
